subject: general
question: Name the first student satellite built by Indian high school student team and launched by NASA.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalamsat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The first student satellite was built by an Indian high school student team and launched by NASA is **Kalamsat**. 
 
• The satellite is named after former President and nuclear scientist Dr APJ Abdul Kalam and is called 'KalamSat'
